purpose: Show that full supply is an available capacity rather than forced consumption when the output remains blocked.

entities: sealed steel chest output with no removal
setup.supply_conditions: Iron plates are available up to the single-lane capacity; source extraction is counted.
setup.removal_conditions: No output removal. Count retained inventory at both window boundaries; collected remains zero.

power_control.circuit_state: no circuit wires or enable condition

expected_not_observed: After warmup reaches the blocked state, collected output and source extraction should both be zero and retained inventory should not change over the interval.
